theme_strategy.vibe: Immersive, premium, distraction-free. Reminiscent of a modern movie theater with lights dimmed. High contrast for readability.

typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' pairing. Wide Display Sans for impactful movie titles, Geometric Body for clean synopsis and metadata.

scales.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use py-16 to py-24 for main sections. gap-6 to gap-8 for grids.
layouts.poster_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 md:gap-6

movie_poster_card.styling: rounded-lg overflow-hidden relative group cursor-pointer bg-neutral-900
movie_poster_card.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 flex flex-col justify-end p-4
movie_poster_card.details_on_hover: Show rating (gold star icon + number), year, and a 2-line truncated synopsis.

hero_banner.styling: relative w-full h-[70vh] md:h-[85vh] flex items-end pb-24
hero_banner.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/60 to-transparent
hero_banner.content_layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 relative z-10 w-full flex flex-col items-start gap-4

header_nav.styling: fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-white/5 transition-colors duration-300

ad_slots.concept: Integrated smoothly without breaking the UX.
ad_slots.styling: w-full bg-[#111111] border border-[#262626] rounded flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
ad_slots.label: text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-neutral-600 absolute top-2 right-2

player_container.styling: w-full aspect-video bg-black rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-white/10 relative flex items-center justify-center
player_container.empty_state: Display a cinematic poster background with a large, glowing red play button in the center.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 for sticky headers and modal overlays. MUST include border-white/5 for edge definition.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]. Glow for primary buttons: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(229,9,20,0.4)].

motion.transitions: NEVER use 'transition: all'. Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out' for colors, or 'transition-transform duration-300 cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' for scaling.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for poster grids. Scale-in for the hero banner.

icons.usage: Use Star (gold) for ratings, Play (white/red) for playback, Search, User, Clock, Calendar.

hero_backgrounds.description: Dark thriller wide shot for featured hero movie.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast by using dark gradient overlays or text-shadows.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='movie-card-play').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using pure React and Tailwind CSS. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (dropdowns, dialogs) but style them to fit the dark cinematic theme.
Always default to Dark Mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle; this is a cinematic experience.
Implement the ad slots as clear placeholder components. They should be visible to demonstrate the monetization capability, with a subtle label 'Publicidade' or 'Anúncio'.
For the admin panel, use a high-density 'Bento' grid layout. It should look like a functional, data-heavy dashboard with clear metrics (Views, Revenue, Users).
Ensure the hero image overlay is not too dark. Max bg-black/60 to keep the image visible.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use #050505 for the darkest background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).
NEVER use generic 'transition: all'. Use specific properties.
NEVER center align text on paragraphs. Keep dense text left-aligned.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Implement data-testid on ALL interactive elements.
Spacing must be generous. Use Tailwind p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals over images. Use opaque or heavily blurred backgrounds.
